subject: Redwood pricing deck & next steps — Acme
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-18T15:12:00Z
Subject: Redwood pricing deck & next steps — Acme

Alex / Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear more about Acme's plan to rollout an in-product assistant for support articles. Quick recap from my side: 

- Primary use case: support article summarization + contextual answer generation for CS agents
- Expected traffic: ~50k API calls/month, peak concurrency around 25 RTTs
- Key constraints: latency < 300ms p50, data residency in US, SOC 2 evidence required

Attached is the pricing deck and an initial estimate based on the usage profile we discussed (see attachment: 20270318-Redwood-Pricing-Deck.pdf). Highlights: 
- Recommended model family: Redwood-Optimized-13B (quantized) for cost/latency balance
- Monthly estimated spend: $8k-$11k depending on batching & KV cache settings
- Dedicated option recommended if you want predictable throughput and private networking

Suggested next steps: 
1) I can walk the team through the deck and the cost assumptions — 30 minutes to step through the estimate and configuration options
2) If the estimate looks good, we can prep a mutual action plan and draft PO/contract
3) We can schedule a short security checklist call to go through SOC 2 artifacts and KMS options

Are you available for a walkthrough next week? I've left a few slots on my calendar here: https://cal.com/ben-redwood/30 — happy to flex.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
